# Research & Projects

Original research exploring population health,
healthcare outcomes, and public policy.

## Featured Projects

### Geographic Disparities in Preventable Mortality

An exploration of geographic variation in
preventable mortality across the United States.

### Predicting Preventable Hospitalizations

An investigation into predictive modeling and
healthcare utilization.

### Evaluating Community-Based Healthcare

A causal evaluation of community-based healthcare
interventions and their impact on outcomes.
